zh: 完整词典、个人词汇书和间隔重复学习现已合并为统一的跨平台 Beta。
新增今日学习、今日复习、预设词库、学习来源选择和释义就绪门槛。
网页与应用新增可选择的缓存清理，逐项显示真实占用空间，并优化窄屏按钮、学习导航和历史切换栏。
Beta 更新器现会同时检查 Beta 与正式通道，并自动选择可用的新版本。
macOS 继续使用原生 SwiftUI、侧栏材质与克制的 Liquid Glass 交互效果。
文档自定义新增实时字体预览与极简模式。
en: The full dictionary, personal vocabulary books, and spaced repetition now share one cross-platform Beta.
Study Beta adds separate Learn and Review views, preset packs, source selection, and a content-readiness gate.
Web and app builds add selective cache cleanup with per-item storage usage plus refined narrow-screen controls, learning navigation, and history switching.
The Beta updater now checks both Beta and stable channels and chooses the newest available release.
macOS keeps a native SwiftUI shell, sidebar material, and restrained interactive Liquid Glass.
Document customization adds a live typography preview and Minimal mode.

zh: 词典、个人词汇书和学习系统已合并到统一 Beta。
新增今日学习、今日复习与可下载预设词库。
学习内容可从已生成词汇书、历史选择和预设词库组合。
释义补全前不会开始复习；新增文档字体预览、极简模式和自定义缓存清理。
学习导航更紧凑流畅，缓存大小清楚可见，并可同时接收 Beta 与正式更新。
en: Unifies the dictionary, personal vocabulary books, and learning system in one Beta.
Adds separate daily learning and review plus downloadable preset packs.
Combine generated books, selected history, and preset packs as study sources.
Review waits for bilingual enrichment; document settings add preview, Minimal mode, and selective cache cleanup.
Learning navigation is more compact and fluid, cache sizes are visible, and both Beta and stable updates are supported.

zh.title: 4.1.0 Beta 3 学习系统
items: 学习顶栏调整为首页、今日学习、今日复习、单词库、统计和学习设置。
学习设置可组合使用正确生成过的词汇书、从历史选择的词条以及服务器预设词库。
新增四级、六级、考研、KET、PET、雅思、专四参考和专八预设包的下载、启用和删除。
旧生成记录中的空释义占位词会先联网补全，只有中英文释义均就绪后才能进入评分。
今日学习结束后可直接进入今日复习。

zh.title: 跨平台界面与本地管理
items: 网页 Beta 合并完整词典、词汇书、生成记录、历史、学习和设置，桌面端采用应用式侧栏，移动端采用六项底栏。
Android 学习六项导航改为与网页一致的浮层分段样式，图标和文字居中，并以轻快的非线性动画自动对齐当前页面。
网页学习标题与说明胶囊改为同行排列并上移；设置版本号紧跟标题，减少首屏无效留白。
历史页面的生成历史和搜索历史切换控件移动到标题栏中央。
网页端和应用端新增可逐项选择的缓存清理，每一项以灰色小字显示准确占用大小，默认不删除词条、生成记录、搜索历史或学习进度。
Beta 应用同时检查 Beta 与正式更新通道；当正式版更新程度更高时会优先提示正式版。
修复生成记录并发写入、失败恢复列表和异常拖拽索引等边缘问题，并清理网页代码检查警告。
macOS 保留原生 SwiftUI 侧栏材质，并在选中项和文档自定义等交互表面使用 Liquid Glass。

zh.title: 文档排版
items: macOS SwiftUI Liquid Glass 自定义窗口补充实时生成字体预览。
新增极简模式，每个词条只保留单词和约五个核心汉译。

en.title: 4.1.0 Beta 3 learning system
items: Adds Home, Learn Today, Review Today, Library, Stats, and Learning Settings navigation.
Study sources can combine generated books, selected history, and server-hosted preset packs.
Adds downloadable CET-4, CET-6, postgraduate, KET, PET, IELTS, TEM reference packs.
Legacy placeholder words are enriched online and cannot enter review before bilingual definitions are ready.
Completing new learning offers a direct path to today's review.

en.title: Cross-platform interface and local management
items: The web Beta unifies the full dictionary, books, generated files, history, learning, and settings with an app-style desktop sidebar and six-item mobile bar.
Android's six learning tabs now use the same floating segmented style as the web, with centered labels and a quick nonlinear alignment animation.
The web learning title and system badge now share one compact row, while the Settings version sits directly beside its title.
Generated and search history switching now sits in the center of the history title bar.
Web and app builds show the exact storage used by every selectable cache category without deleting entries, generated files, search history, or learning progress by default.
Beta builds check both Beta and stable update channels and prefer the newest applicable release.
Fixes concurrent generated-record writes, failed-list restoration, invalid drag indices, and all remaining web lint warnings.
macOS keeps native SwiftUI sidebar material and uses Liquid Glass on selected and document-customization interaction surfaces.

en.title: Document layout
items: The macOS SwiftUI Liquid Glass sheet now includes a live typography preview.
Minimal mode keeps only each word and about five core Chinese meanings.
